title: RosterContract
description: The Scout/Casting-Director output (Act I, Phase B). Every seat must justify itself from manuscript content; a seat with no justifying_quote is auto-rejected. The contract is shown to the author (paused) on non-quick runs before the fleet runs.

paper_type.description: One or more of: meta-analysis, observational-causal, RCT-experiment, theory-proof, ML-benchmark, simulation-methods, structural-quantitative, descriptive-measurement, qualitative.

precis.description: Neutral one-paragraph account of what the paper claims to do and why it says it matters. No praise, no critique.

mandatory_floor.description: seat_ids that are always-on and cannot be dropped, incl. the paper-type-bound specialist.

jurisdiction.description: The narrow remit of this seat.

justifying_quote.description: A manuscript quote that warrants this seat. Empty => auto-reject.

rival_of.description: seat_id of the competing-tradition pair, or null.

not_staffed.description: Dimensions deliberately NOT staffed, and why. Makes silence visible.
